_comment: Batch B2: four of test-087's six values, re-sourced behaviour-first on 2026-10-23. Each edit carries the BmAK behaviour and the take that can fail (rule R1) before it may be packed; the batch table is T_PLAN.md section 4, Batch B2.
source: T_PLAN.md section 4 Batch B2 + Working/Translation/T1_TRANSLATION.md sections 6/8/10
base_build: Builds/test-085 (the build to roll back to)
status: cleared-for-build: behaviour and take named for every value; rows stay `next` until their take passes (R4)

edits.behaviour: none: BmAK has no grip or traction member under boost (OFFSETS.json has no grip field; the boost evidence is BoostTorqueVSpeedCurve, torque only)
edits.take: A9 0-100 with and without boost: boost improves 0-100, no grip snap on engage
edits.why: donor's shipped value; also the fleet maximum (1.2..2, n=145). Build 5.68 was outside every shipped range for this member - an undeclared out-of-domain value (R3), not a translation

edits.behaviour: boost extends the torque band 2100 -> 3000 cm/s at the same torque floor (75.6 -> 108 km/h, +32.4 km/h; ratios x1.30 -> x2.10) - a bound, not a number
edits.take: A2 airfield top-speed run, boost off then on: terminal speed rises while boosting, delta recorded
edits.why: donor's shipped value, inside the domain 30..60 and above the curve's +32.4 km/h band; the fleet median (40, n=145) agrees but is not the citation; build 50.46 has no source

edits.behaviour: none: no brake-lock member and no anti-lock behaviour in the streams (BmAK brake members: MaxBrakeTorque, EbrakeTime, EBrakeBrakeForce, Handbrake*, BlockThrottleUntilReleased)
edits.take: A5 braking 100 -> 0 on tarmac, full stop: stop distance <= ~100 m (3.5-3.8 m/s2), no lock-up
edits.why: donor's shipped value; fleet median -1 reads as the unused sentinel, land IQR -1..1 (n=271). Build 5 had no source (Batch C disproved 'vanilla Serpente = 5')

edits.behaviour: same as front: no BmAK member, no anti-lock behaviour
edits.take: A5 braking 100 -> 0 on tarmac, full stop
edits.why: donor's shipped value; same as front

withdrawn.why: rejected under rule R2: BmAK has no countersteer gain (it has the rate - T-ST7 - and the drift pair), and the row carries a behaviour, so a 6 t fleet median would out-vote it. The build's 2.0 is the donor's shipped value; gate A7 runs against the live build
same as countersteer_speed_factor: rejected under R2, donor's shipped 1.5 stands; gate A7
